text:
alex_sales: Quick summary — DevonAI wants a 12mo dedicated commit: baseline 24x A100-equivalent GPUs, autoscale up to 72 for bursts. They're asking for a 30% commit discount + 3x burst rate with no overage fees for first 90 days. Need deal desk approval/ops check.

devon_cust: confirming — baseline 24 reserved, autoscale to 72 on demand, burst billed at whatever we agree. Also need SOC2 scoping and a short SOW/PO before POC start. Can we get the 90d free-burst in writing?

mira_se: technical: autoscale + burst is fine but if we mix A100/V100 (to meet capacity) perf varies. Suggest pinned baseline on all-A100 nodegroup for latency-sensitive endpoints and a mixed burst pool. KV cache warmup note — cold-start token cost will be higher for first 10–20 requests.

sam_ops: capacity check — likely OK in us-west-2 but need 4–6 weeks to reserve 24 A100-equivalent nodes if they want full isolation. Autoscale to 72 can be soft (best-effort) with regional fallback. If they insist on hard SLA for burst capacity, that's an ops carveout. :eyes:

jon_finance: need unit economics before approving 30% off + free burst window. Questions: expected avg sustained utilization (tokens/hr), ARR/QoQ revenue, and whether customer will sign an early-termination fee. Alternative: 20% commit discount + 30 day free-burst credit.

laura_dealdesk: flagging for deal desk review — free overage workaround requires legal + revenue_ops signoff. We need: 1) business justification, 2) loss-mitigation (min monthly commitment), 3) security questionnaire answers. If we offer 90d free burst, ask for a consumption escrow or minimum invoice.

alex_sales: Devon's target ARR is ~$1.2M ARR over 12mo if they hit projected usage. Expected avg utilization for baseline ~65%, spikes to 100% during batch jobs. Quick numbers: 
- baseline: 24 GPUs
- target avg util: 65%
- projected tokens/hr -> shared in followup doc (soon)
Will push security questionnaire & PO today.

laura_dealdesk: workable compromise: 25% commit discount on baseline + burst surcharge capped at 2.5x for first 60 days, then review. Require early-termination fee scaled to remaining term. That reduces revenue risk.

mira_se: putting a proposed rate snippet here for clarity:
```
baseline_hourly: $18/gpu-hour (A100-eq)
burst_multiplier: x2.5 (capped) for first 60d
post_trial_burst: x3.0
reserved_discount: 25% off list for 12mo
```
Keep in mind mixed-pool pricing could be ~15% lower per-hour for V100 fallback nodes.

devon_cust: 25% + capped burst might work. One ask: free 30 days of burst credits (not unlimited), enough for POC. If we sign PO this week can we start POC next Monday? Also need the SOC2 answers and an IP/data-handling clause in SOW.

jon_finance: if we do 30d free credits, propose a usage escrow: free credits = up to X GPU-hours (we define X = baseline * 24h * 30d * 0.8). Anything above moves to billed burst at agreed multiplier. That keeps cost exposure bounded.

laura_dealdesk: please upload the security questionnaire answers and the proposed SOW language to this thread or update the deal doc. I'll run the pricing exception template once we have the PO + revenue numbers.

alex_sales: will upload security questionnaire PDF and a draft PO by EOD. PO will include baseline 24 nodes, billing cadence monthly, and ETR clause. Also pinging @procure-bot to create provisional invoice.

procure-bot: Created provisional invoice #PR-2025-331 for review. Note: invoice reflects 25% discount on baseline; burst handled as surcharge line item.

sam_ops: one more ops note — need region(s) + VPC isolation; if they want dedicated tenancy we need extra lead time and a 2% infra surcharge. Confirm region by EOD to lock schedule.

devon_cust: we prefer us-west-2 + eu-west-1 for DR. Dedicated tenancy ok if needed, go ahead with standard VPC-first plan. We'll review PO today. 👍

alex_sales: thanks — next steps: 1) I'll upload security Q + PO (EOD), 2) finance + dealdesk to sign pricing exception (target 48h), 3) ops to confirm scheduling after region confirmation. If anyone needs raw numbers I can paste ARR/model in thread.

laura_dealdesk: copying revenue_ops for approval. If we get PO + secQ + customer ack on capped burst we can route approval today. :thumbsup:

devon_cust: final: POC kickoff target Mon (6 business days). Appreciate the quick turnaround.
